brief: A base with a bay bin in one half of its cell.

requirements.requirement: A base (hex base cell) in the build
requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full, a Full hex base at cell (0,0,0, level 0).

requirements.requirement: A bay bin in one half of its cell
requirements.evidence: Added bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-half, a half-cell bin filling one half of the base cell; mesh check is clear. I did not use a 'bay' part: the catalog's bay trays (hex-bin-bay-*) stand in an empty position touching three cells and cannot sit inside a single base's own cell. So this is a half-cell bin, not a true bay tray.

finish.summary: Built a Full hex base at (0,0,0) with a half-cell bin (hex-bin-half) in one half of it. check_build: meshClash clear, no rule errors (one info note about open cap faces, which is optional). The brief's 'bay bin' was interpreted as the half-cell bin because catalog bay trays need three neighbouring cells; if a true bay tray was intended, it would require building a three-cell cluster first.
